claim: Engineering references only; none is asserted as a normative product standard for the GraphX fixture waveform.

references.title: Multipath propagation and parameterization of its characteristics
references.adaptation: The harness represents a channel as a normalized linear transversal filter of delayed complex replicas and reports tap power, mean delay, RMS delay spread, and Doppler separately. No ITU environment distribution or qualification limit is imported.

references.title: Study on channel model for frequencies from 0.5 to 100 GHz
references.adaptation: Only the TDL vocabulary—relative delays, normalized tap powers, fading coefficients, and Doppler—is used. GraphX v1 uses small explicit engineering tap sets, not a claimed 3GPP deployment scenario.

references.title: Wideband transmission systems; Data transmission equipment operating in the 2,4 GHz ISM band and using wide band modulation techniques; Harmonised Standard for access to radio spectrum
references.adaptation: Motivates calibrated wanted/blocker frequency and level sweeps. Its bands, category limits, companion-device procedure, and regulatory claims are not applied to this unrelated engineering fixture.

references.title: Jakes fading model revisited
sections: sum-of-sinusoids Rayleigh fading construction and second-order behavior
references.adaptation: Recorded as the peer-reviewed basis for a future time-varying Rayleigh sum-of-sinusoids option. Phase 3 v1 gates use reproducible per-capture Rayleigh/Rician coefficients plus independently measured static Doppler; the limitation is explicit.
